description: This file defines the 'TransactionalState<TState>' class, which manages transactional state with support for read and update operations, transaction context handling, and lifecycle participation within Orleans grains. It implements transaction semantics, state copying, and logging.

classes.name: TransactionalState<TState>
classes.description: Manages transactional state with support for read/write operations, transaction context, and lifecycle participation within Orleans grains.

methods.name: PerformRead<TResult>
methods.description: Performs a read operation within a transaction, ensuring proper locking and state merging.

methods.name: PerformUpdate<TResult>
methods.description: Performs an update operation within a transaction, including state copying and lock management.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the transactional state to the grain lifecycle for setup.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes the transactional state, sets up resources, and recovers state.

methods.name: CopyResult<TResult>
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the result using the appropriate data copier.
